scenes.audio: A sharp, clicking sound of plastic hitting plastic, followed by the hum of low-frequency electricity.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A hand with fair skin and light pink nail polish inserts a white rectangular power adapter into a white electrical outlet. The wall is light blue, and the floor is a dark wood laminate. The camera is static, focusing on the mechanical connection of the plug.

scenes.audio: Mechanical whirring and a muffled thump as the view shifts behind the wall.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A cross-section view reveals a secret room behind the blue wall. Inside, a man (roughly 20-30 years old, tan skin, short brown hair, wearing a brown cowboy hat, a yellow safety vest, a white t-shirt, and blue jeans) is sitting in a blue leather armchair. Next to him is a large hamster wheel and a sleeping orange hamster on a small green rug.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: The man in the cowboy hat jumps up from the armchair, looking startled. He pulls a black whip from his side. The room is dimly lit by a single industrial wall lamp. Copper pipes and steampunk-style machinery are visible in the background.

scenes.audio: A loud whip crack sound effect. Man: 'Get up on that wheel and get to spinning!'
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The man cracks the whip toward the orange hamster. The hamster wakes up and scurries toward the metal exercise wheel. The camera follows the hamster's movement. The lighting is cool-toned with teal tiles on the floor.

scenes.audio: Rapid, rhythmic patter of hamster paws on metal, accompanied by a high-pitched mechanical whine.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The hamster runs inside the metal wheel, which features a green and yellow sunburst design in the center. The wheel begins to spin rapidly. A rubber belt attached to the wheel's axle starts moving.

scenes.audio: Electrical buzzing and crackling sounds, intensifying in volume and pitch. A low synth bass swell.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The camera zooms into the machinery. Blue electrical arcs and glowing energy pulses travel through a transparent generator housing. Gears turn rapidly as the energy intensifies into bright white-blue bolts.

scenes.audio: Powerful electrical 'whoosh' sound as the energy travels through the wires.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: The blue energy bolts travel through the copper pipes in the secret room, exiting through the wall back into the external room. The energy flows through a white charging cable lying on the dark wood floor. The camera pans to follow the energy flow.

scenes.audio: A digital 'ding' sound indicating a connection has been made.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A man in a white t-shirt and jeans sits on a dark sofa, holding a smartphone. The blue energy travels up the cable and into the phone. The man's face is partially visible in the reflection of the phone screen.

scenes.audio: A satisfying, melodic 'chime' sound confirming the device is charging. The background music fades out.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: A close-up of the phone screen shows a charging animation with a '25%' battery indicator. The background is a soft blue spotlight effect. The hand holding the phone is steady, showing the device actively receiving power.
